newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page- April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page- April 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
* Eight Senate Republicans have backed legislation which would raise cigarette taxes to pay for health insurance for children who are not insured.
* President Bill Clinton offered to make more cuts of $18 billion in forecast Medicare spending over the next five years to help reach accord on eliminating the Federal deficit.
* The Vatican said it chose conservative intellectual Archbishop Francis George of Portland, Oregon as the new Archbishop of Chicago.

* A California federal appeals court upheld the constitutionality of the state's proposition 209, ruling voters had the right to ban the use of racial or sex-based preferences in state-run affirmative action programmes.

* Men's clothing sales are rising. While women still spend more money on clothes, many retailers say their men's business, especially brand-label sportswear, is growing as fast as women's if not faster.
* Russians are obsessed about what to do with the bodies of Lenin, father of the Russian Revolution, and Czar Nicholas II, whose execution Lenin ordered in 1918.
